# Uniswap v4 PositionManager test vectors

Calls to `modifyLiquidities(bytes,uint256)` on the Uniswap v4 `PositionManager` on Ethereum.

```solidity
// unlockData: abi.encode(bytes actions, bytes[] params)
function modifyLiquidities(bytes calldata unlockData, uint256 deadline) external payable;
```

Descriptor: [`example-uniswap-v4-position-manager.json`](./example-uniswap-v4-position-manager.json)

## Mint an ETH/USDC position

Actions `0x02` (mint), `0x0d` (settle pair) and `0x14` (sweep). ETH is the zero address. `address(1)` stands for the sender.

- Chain ID: 1
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0xbD216513d74C8cf14cf4747E6AaA6420FF64ee9e`
- Value: 1 ETH

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Manage liquidity
Action 1: Mint a position with up to 1 ETH and 2600 USDC
  Token 0: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Token 1: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48
  Fee: 0.05%
  Hooks: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Lower tick: -200000
  Upper tick: -195000
  Maximum token 0: 1 ETH
  Maximum token 1: 2600 USDC
  Position owner: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Action 2: Pay tokens
  Token 0: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Token 1: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48
Action 3: Return leftover tokens
  Token: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Deadline: 2026-10-13 12:00:00 UTC
```

## Add liquidity to an existing position

The pool, and so the tokens of the amounts, depend on the position's state, so the amounts are shown raw.

- Chain ID: 1
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0xbD216513d74C8cf14cf4747E6AaA6420FF64ee9e`
- Value: 0.5 ETH

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Manage liquidity
Action 1: Add liquidity
  Position: 61234
  Liquidity: 500000000000000
  Maximum token 0: 500000000000000000
  Maximum token 1: 1300000000
Action 2: Pay tokens
  Token 0: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Token 1: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48
Deadline: 2026-10-13 12:00:00 UTC
```

## Unsupported action

Action `0x06` (`SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE`) is not supported by `PositionManager`. The descriptor rejects it.

- Chain ID: 1
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0xbD216513d74C8cf14cf4747E6AaA6420FF64ee9e`
- Value: 0 ETH

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Rejected: no case for value 0x06
```
